content:
marta: FYI — EmberAPI signed NDA. They want a 72h eval focused on parity with their current vendor. Core asks: identical webhook callbacks, same field names, and no change to retry semantics.

liam: Noted. Their vendor sends callbacks to /callback with X-Request-Id and a nested events array. We can build a facade that re-emits exact shape. Main mismatch: they expect 'status_code' int on error instead of our 'error.code'. I can map that.

tori: Also watch streaming vs chunked responses. Ember's consumer expects a single final JSON per call; their existing integration drops streaming tokens. We'll need to ensure our proxy buffers and emits final payload to match.

sam: For the token accounting question: their tokenization uses a custom GPT tokenizer and counts whitespace differently. We'll run a paired tokenization run and deliver a multiplier. For the POC we recommend a fixed trial credit (e.g., 50k tokens) and we log both native and Ember-counted tokens.

ken: Security asks: they require mTLS to origin callbacks and an IP CIDR allowlist. Also a completed questionnaire and a copy of our encryption architecture doc. @marta can you share the questionnaire link?

marta: Uploaded ember-security-q.pdf to the drive and pinged their secops. Also included our KMS-integration notes.

legal: Ember wants a short POC addendum: 15-day retention max and liability capped to POC scope. We can do that but need to confirm who signs and if we need an SLA for uptime during POC.

liam: Quick curl example for the consumer-side smoke (we'll proxy their vendor calls into our /v1/run):

```
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.dev/ember/run \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -H "X-Api-Key: EMBER_TEST" \ 
  -d '{"input":"Write a short summary...","callback_url":"https://ember.test/callback"}'
```

The proxy will buffer streaming and POST final JSON to their callback with original X-Request-Id preserved.

tori: Test matrix I propose: webhook shape tests (1k events), semantic parity (2k prompts, top-1 BLEU/ROUGE), rate-limit parity (burst 200rps), and retry semantics (simulate 5xx and ensure backoff match).

sam: I'll spin up the Dedicated pool for deterministic runs. ETA to start jobs: 18h. Need a small committed reservation for repeatability.

ken: Infra needs destination IPs for their firewall and mTLS cert validation info. @marta can you collect Ember ops contact?

marta: Ember ops: infra@emberapi.com. Also they sent a CSV of their webhook sample payloads, uploaded to the drive.

legal: Also flag: Ember's contract team wants a clause preventing us from altering their payload structure during POC. We'll include a "no-struct-change" clause for the POC only.

infra-bot: env: staging-ember-poc created  instance=dedicated-small region=us-east-1

deploy-bot: build started: ember/compat-proxy #489 ETA 7m :rocket:

liam: Two probable diffs to call out in the demo: (1) token multiplier (we'll show a scatterplot), (2) micro-phrasing variance due to different default decoding logits. Recommend running with temperature=0 and deterministic seeds for exactness tests.

tori: Also call out that some nested event arrays might reorder keys; we'll preserve insertion order but JSON consumers that compare serialized strings will see diffs. Suggest canonicalize before diff.

sam: Action items: liam build proxy + smoke; tori run test matrix; legal draft POC addendum; ken gather IPs and certs. Target: POC live and first parity report within 72h.

marta: Ember asked if billing can be matched exactly. Short answer: only by measuring their tokenization on a shared sample and then deciding whether to bill Ember-counted tokens or native tokens. We'll propose reconciliation at month-end.

legal: I'll prepare a tight addendum and include a 15-day purge flow. Who owns the purge implementation?

sam: I'll add a purge tag and a scheduled job that deletes persisted payloads after 15 days. Will share runbook.

marta: Great. If any blocker (SOC2 ask, cert mismatch) pops up, escalate to AE. I have ember-acct exec on cc. :thumbsup:
